articles.title: Fenix Flexin isn’t even denying using AI to make ‘Rubberz’ anymore
articles.summary: It took long enough, but now LA rapper Fenix Flexin appears to have admitted using AI for the 80s synth pop-themed song "Rubberz." articles.title: Watching Roku’s AI channel is like eating from a trough
articles.summary: The appeal of free ad-supported streaming television (FAST) channels has always been the way they make it easier to (re)discover classic films and series. But Roku's latest experiment in the FAST space has less to do with traditionally produced entertainment and is entirely focused on giving viewers access to a constant source of AI-generated content.
